summary: The requirement document describes one platform for a general insurer to take in, survey, approve and settle motor insurance claims. Policyholders report claims online, the system reads documents and photos with AI, surveyors work from a map, and fraud rules and approvals apply before settlement. It must connect to the existing policy system and bank file system, and be supported for three years.

evidence.quote: Policyholders shall report a claim online with the policy number, accident details and place, and upload photos of the damage, the driving licence and the FIR where needed.
